posts.text:
Gemini 4 Argon reaches Google AI Pro users in Antigravity

TestingCatalog reports Google AI Pro subscribers can now use Gemini 4 Argon in Antigravity under a dedicated weekly quota, while Google cites 97 of 134 bugs closed in under three hours.

https://theaipost.net/story/gemini-4-argon-antigravity-pro/

Three lab-grown brain organoids read Braille at 83% accuracy

Bristol researchers fed Braille touch data into clusters of about 10,000 living human neurons: one organoid got 61% of letters right, three together got 83%, 404 Media reports.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-organoid-braille-bristol/

Taiwan plans US industrial parks of up to $4 billion for Nvidia suppliers
https://theaipost.net/story/find-taiwan-us-industrial-parks-nvidia/

Opus 5.5 fast mode runs up to 2.5x quicker at double the price

Anthropic's docs say Claude Opus 5.5 fast mode delivers up to 2.5x more output tokens a second for $8 and $40 per million tokens, with no waitlist or beta header.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-opus-55-fast-mode/

FTC serves subpoenas on OpenAI and Anthropic over security incidents

The FTC has sent civil subpoenas to OpenAI and Anthropic about security incidents and safeguards, Axios reported, and an FTC spokesperson confirmed the action to CBS News.

https://theaipost.net/story/ftc-subpoenas-openai-anthropic/

PrismML opens Bonsai 2, ternary models from 0.43 GB

PrismML says its Apache 2.0 Bonsai 2 models run in 0.43 GB, 0.95 GB and 2 GB, and that the 9B reaches up to 34 tokens a second on an iPhone 18 Pro Max.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-prismml-bonsai-2/

Vera Rubin posts up to 5.7x GB300's throughput per megawatt

Artificial Analysis says Nvidia's Vera Rubin NVL72 serves up to about 5.7x the throughput per megawatt of GB300 on DeepSeek V4 Pro in its first agentic benchmark results.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-vera-rubin-aa-agentperf/

128 GB RTX Spark laptop runs an agent workload on Qwen3.8 27B in 18.7 minutes

Artificial Analysis says a prototype Surface laptop with Nvidia's RTX Spark chip finished its local agent test about twice as fast as an M5 Pro MacBook Pro.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-rtx-spark-laptop-agentperf-local/

Apple's Joswiak 'not threatened' by OpenAI hardware

Apple marketing chief Greg Joswiak told TIME "We don't feel threatened" by OpenAI's devices, as Apple said it found no evidence for OpenAI's claim that an ex-OpenAI hire took 100 files.

https://theaipost.net/story/apple-joswiak-openai-hardware-trade-secrets/
